relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from the arXiv title page (arXiv:1705.01853v2, hep-th): single author, subject and identifier match the seeded entry. Citation site: appendix-standard-model/sm-gauge-truncation.md:9, in prose via \cite. LOAD-BEARING AND CORRECT - the match is close to verbatim. The block writes that 'the global form of the physical gauge group is (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1))/Gamma with Gamma a subgroup of Z_6 undetermined by current experiment', and the paper's abstract states that there is an ambiguity in the Standard Model gauge group, that it is SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1)/Gamma with Gamma a subgroup of Z6, and that Gamma cannot be determined by current experiments. The citation does real work: it is what licenses the block's deliberate containment-not-isomorphism framing, i.e. it is the reason the conjecture does not overclaim. Supporting rather than core because the folio consumes the paper's ambiguity statement, not its line-operator spectra.

keyResults.statement: The Standard Model gauge group is (SU(3) x SU(2) x U(1))/Gamma with Gamma a subgroup of Z_6 that current experiment cannot determine.
keyResults.useForFolio: Justifies the containment-not-isomorphism caveat in conj:sm-gauge-truncation and blocks any future isomorphism claim there.

keyResults.statement: The allowed line-operator spectra and theta-angle periodicities differ between the choices of Gamma, so they are the observables that would fix it.
keyResults.useForFolio: Names the falsifiable discriminant a completed QOU derivation would have to predict - the concrete follow-up the block already gestures at.
